user.title: Configure Main Climate
user.description: Select the main climate entity that controls your HVAC system. At least one fallback zone is required for the system to function properly.

zone_initial.title: Configure Initial Fallback Zone
zone_initial.description: Configure the first fallback zone. This zone is required to ensure at least one valve can be opened when the minimum valve requirement is active.

error.already_configured: This integration is already configured with this main climate entity

edit_main.title: Edit Main Climate Entity
edit_main.description: Update the main climate entity that controls your HVAC system.

add_zone.title: Add New Zone
add_zone.description: Configure a new heating/cooling zone with temperature sensor and valve control.

delete_zone.title: Delete Zone
delete_zone.description: Select a zone to delete. Note: You cannot delete the last fallback zone.
